subject: Gateway renewal timing and mutual action plan - staging windows
messages:
From: Amy Parsons <amy.parsons@cloudflare.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@cloudflare.com
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Edge gateway + WAF renewal options

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the heads-up last week. Attached is a short packet with three options for our edge gateway + WAF renewal that map to the usage tiers you mentioned: Standard, Enhanced (with Bot Management), and Dedicated Edge Pools. See attached: CF_Renewal_Options_Q3.pdf.

Highlights: 
- Pricing scenarios include a multi-year discount and a usage cap line for predictable spend.
- We can offer a 15% credit if the renewal is executed and PO issued by 2026-07-01 (applies to Enhanced tier).
- SLA language change (latency & DDoS response) is proposed in section 3. Legal is ready for a short redline window.

If it helps, I can set up a 30-minute call with our solutions engineer and procurement to walk through the MAP and timeboxes. Are you available tomorrow between 10–12 PT?

Best,
Amy Parsons
Enterprise Sales, Cloudflare
amy.parsons@cloudflare.com
Attachment: CF_Renewal_Options_Q3.pdf (summary + pricing)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Amy Parsons <amy.parsons@cloudflare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Edge gateway + WAF renewal options

Amy — thanks for the packet and the early heads up. Two quick items from our side before we schedule: 

1) Renewal overlap: Fastly and Cloudflare windows are currently within 30 days of each other. We want to avoid both being live on new contracts at the same time to reduce procurement and cutover risk. Can your team flex the PO window by +/- 30 days?

2) SLA redlines: Marcus and I need the proposed SLA changes called out in the PDF as line items (short diff) — that will speed legal review.

We're available tomorrow 11–11:30 PT for a short call; Marissa, Marcus, can you join? If not, propose two slots and we'll pick.

— Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Platform Operations | Redwood Inference
Evelyn.hart@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Edge gateway + WAF renewal options

Looping in a quick procurement view. Notes: 
- Budget quarter: our FYQ3 commit closes 2026-07-15; having the PO by 2026-07-01 is ideal for recognizing discounts.
- Staggering: I strongly prefer we stagger vendor renewals by ~30 days. If Cloudflare can accept a PO window that ends 2026-07-01 and Fastly can push to 2026-07-31, we avoid parallel legal/ops churn.
- Quant economics: Cloudflare's Enhanced looks slightly cheaper at our expected egress profile (see calc in vendor_renewal_timeline.xlsx) but Fastly's per-request saving is better for spikes. We should keep both options open and choose by engineering cutover readiness.

Action items I recommend before the call: 
- Ask Cloudflare for a redline-ready SLA diff (evelyn requested this).
- Get Fastly's current renewal price sheet (I asked them this morning).
- Build a short MAP with dates for approvals, PO submission, legal redline, and cutover windows (I can draft).

— Marcus
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: vendor_renewal_timeline.xlsx (internal cost/TCO worksheet)

To: Amy Parsons <amy.parsons@cloudflare.com>, contracts@fastly.com, sales@akamai.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal options + MAP (mutual action plan)

Team — forwarding our thread and a short MAP draft. Goal: confirm timing and legal windows so we can coordinate purchase orders without overlap. Please review the bullets below and add a single point of contact for legal redlines.

MAP DRAFT (high level):
- 2026-06-10: Vendor proposals submitted (received for Cloudflare).
- 2026-06-11 to 2026-06-13: Redwood legal to receive redline-ready SLA diffs.
- 2026-06-14 to 2026-06-20: Internal approvals (Engineering sign-off on cutover plan + Finance PO prep).
- Target PO submission windows (one vendor at a time):
  • Cloudflare: PO issued by 2026-07-01 to capture 15% credit.
  • Fastly: target PO issued by 2026-07-31 (staggered).
  • Akamai: TBD — prefer latest date for risk diversification.
- Cutover coordination: engagement runbook to be shared one week prior to any change.

Please confirm your legal contacts and whether the PO windows above are acceptable. Also attaching our internal timeline and cost worksheet (vendor_renewal_timeline.xlsx) for context.

Forwarded message follows — see earlier thread for details.
